banner.title: Out on stage 3 — French Pass at sunrise
banner.body: Rolling for Mount Guyot at 05:00. This is the stage the whole schedule was built around: French Pass cresting at first light, then Georgia Pass and the Continental Divide. 38.9 miles and the highest ground of the route. Stages 1 and 2 are done, 76 miles in.
